title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: I believe that loving one’s self is a prerequisite to loving others: our relationships with others are all mirrors of our relationship with ourselves. As a counsellor since 2008, I understand that life can be challenging sometimes, and we can lose our way in it. I treat my clients with warmth, empathy, and unconditional support, giving them the space and confidence that they need to walk through the pains of their growth and once again find their love for their true self. https://www.psychologytoday.com/au/counselling/brand-counselling-services-bentleigh-east-vic/1061033

name: Patrick McIvor
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I'm a counsellor specialising in trauma, loss, and change, based in Melbourne and available online, Australia-wide. I work with adults during challenging times, offering a supportive space to regain stability, strengthen day to day functioning, and rebuild a sense of direction and identity. My approach is integrative, meaning I draw flexibly on evidence-based therapies combining person-centred, relational, cognitive behavioural, narrative and mindfulness based approaches.
